label: D2: chose a1 but landed in S2 (rare), after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), almost exclusively when the reached state is S2 (99.8% of mass) and the choice was a1, i.e. a rare a1->S2 transition (95% of mass; covers 99.5% of the top activation quartile). All variables are observed at D2 (state and last-action inputs). Activation is strongly boosted when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward==0, 93% of mass), and is largest in runs of repeated unrewarded a1->S2 rare trials, late in the episode (rate rises with ep_trial; silent before trial ~20), while S1 is the good state and the model value is low (never active when value > 7.54). It does not fire at D1 or GO, on S1 arrivals, or on common a2->S2 arrivals (only weak, ~5% of mass). The bare rare-a1->S2 predicate has high recall (0.87, mass 0.95) but low precision (0.21); adding prev_reward==0 gives P 0.52 / R 0.72 / F1 0.61 / mass 0.89 on dev. Many a1->S2 events after a non-reward remain silent (e.g. early in an episode or when the model value is high), so the feature appears to be gated by an internal low-value / surprise state rather than purely by the inputs.
